sections.content_markdown: Matter is a physical entity that has mass and occupies space. Chairs, tables, notebooks, pens, ice, water, air- are all matter. All matters may exist in three different states- solid, liquid and gaseous states. They have their own characteristics and properties in all three states. This chapter will focus on these issues.

figures.description: A glass containing liquid water and an ice cube, with additional ice cubes and water being poured into it, demonstrating solid and liquid states of matter.
